object.name: evi_squine_simple
object.digest: A basic implementation of Rasmus Ekman's 'squine wave' oscillator with audio rate modulation
object.description: An extremely versatile phase modulation oscillator which can morph shape and does not alias (up to a certain point). Inlets are available for linear and logarithmic FM modulation, as well as optionally audio rate control over the shape morphing.

inlets.name: freq
inlets.digest: Oscillator frequency in Hz or Pitch depending on @freqmode attribute.

inlets.name: pitch
inlets.digest: FM the oscillator frequency, in Pitch units.

inlets.name: freq
inlets.digest: FM the oscillator frequency, in Hz units.

inlets.name: harmonics
inlets.digest: One of two main wave shaping controls along with inlet 5. Harmonics normalised 0..1. At 0, no harmonics are added and the output is sine-wave-like (if inlet 5 'duty cycle' is set at it's default 0.5). Increasing this value gradually adds harmonics to the waveform as it morphs from sine-like to square-wave-like.

inlets.name: duty
inlets.digest: One of two main wave shaping controls along with inlet 4. PWM normalised 0..1. Shifts the waveform from negative to positive saw-wave-like through the shape created by inlet 4 ('harmonics').

outlets.name: phasemod
outlets.digest: Oscillator phase sync 0..1 post phase modulation.
